title: Lubbuu Abbayyaa Dararamaa jirtu
intro: Bara cunqursaa guddaa keessa, yeroo abbaan irree tokko gara jabina guutuudhaan biyyattii bulchu, lubbuun tokko jajjabina mootummaa irra daandii amantii filatte. Fakkiin kun garaa humnaa keessa kan jiraate ta’us ergaa raajii gad of deebisu tokkoo keessatti dhugaa argate. Imalli isaanii obsa, wareegama fi amantii hin sochoone irratti barumsa yeroo hin qabne ta’a ture. Nama dinqisiisaa sadarkaa biyya lafaa caalaa gammachuu Waaqayyoo filate kana adda baasuu dandeessaa?
clues: Masaraa humna guddaa qabu keessa jiraadheera, ta’us onneen koo ergaa gad of deebisu keessatti dhugaa argate.
Bu'aa na mudatu beekee qajeelfama Muusaa hordofuu filadhe.
Gabroomfataa bara kootti humna guddaa qabutti heerumuun ture, taʼus waaqolii sobaa isaa nan gana ture.
Waaqa Tokkichatti amanuu kootiin waanan adabame, gidiraan koo cimaa ture.
Gidiraan cimaan yommuu na mudate illee amantii koo keessatti gonkumaa hin raafamne.
Gooftaan koo obsa kootti gammadee jannata keessatti bakka kabajamaa naaf filate.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Waraana waliin karaa Rabbii irratti loluu
Fara'oon dura dhaabbachuu fi amantii labsuu
trial.answer: Fara'oon dura dhaabbachuu fi amantii labsuu

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
